why: Picked from validation only (Phase 3), before the test set was ever loaded. Default planned recipe: isolated-die denoise keeps 1-die-thin scratches (median dropped Scratch F1 0.373 -> 0.338), and K=32 keeps the feature vector small for browser inference.

models.final-logreg: main model: calibrated logistic regression on the ring features
models.final-svm: second model: linear SVM on the same features
models.B2-flat-logistic: baseline: logistic regression on 1024 flat fail pixels
models.B2-flat-random-forest: baseline: strongest Phase 2 model, random forest on 1024 flat fail pixels
